Finding the empty DELETE bug by testing against real services, then searching the gateway for the same mistake, was very good work. I accept that the OTP and gateway issues were caught before release. Still, please log each as a Jira Bug linked to EIT-8403, with the root cause and fix, so we can see where defects come from.

Your learning about fake services hiding integration bugs is important. Martin Fowler's Contract Tests fill this gap. A contract test is a small test that checks your fake still behaves like the real Billing service. Please add one for the credits call. The re-runnable migrator also follows his Parallel Change idea for the Billing to Portal move, so the old and new paths can live together until clients switch.
